ios.desc:
MinimaTXT is a minimalist, lightning-fast plain text editor for iPhone.
For people who prefer focus over features.

- 100% local storage — no cloud, no sync, no servers
- Open and edit .txt files instantly
- Full Undo/Redo support
- Auto-save on close, background, and every 30 seconds
- Full-text search with instant result highlighting
- Easy import and export of your files
- Batch export as ZIP

No ads. No tracking. No sign-up. Just text.

show_hn.title: Show HN: MinimaTXT – local-only .txt notes App for iPhone

quotes.text: Built a minimal text editor for iPhone that works with plain .txt files stored locally. No accounts, no cloud sync, no indexing. Includes basic internal search. Can use the system’s offline speech-to-text, which works well enough for quick voice memos. Not optimized for iPad yet.
